title: This stock tripled in a year — and most people can't say what it does

beats.narration: One stock is up over 300% in a year — and most people can't say what it actually does.
Palantir builds the software governments and giant companies use to make sense of their data.
Its new AI platform is selling so fast the company can barely hire quickly enough to keep up.
Revenue is growing around 40% a year, and the business is now solidly profitable.
But here's the catch: it trades at over 200 times earnings — priced for years of perfection.
Incredible business, terrifying price tag. Follow for more market breakdowns.
